en.text:
Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• #e${20+#d} Aim Assist and #e${25+#d} Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased <title Accuracy Cone Growth [G_conegrowth] />

<special/>Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.

Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.
